visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for sticky header. bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid strokes (border-white/10). No soft shadows, use sharp boundaries.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the background to avoid digital flatness.

component_name.accordion: Use Shadcn Accordion for 'More details'. Full-width, tap-friendly headers (min 48px), downward chevron on right.
component_name.button: Shadcn Button. Sharp corners (rounded-none or rounded-sm). Action buttons in Volt Blue or Pure White.
component_name.alert: Shadcn Alert for the privacy disclosure. Muted, text-sm.
component_name.separator: Shadcn Separator for dividing technical detail sections.

grids.bento_grid: Mode B (High Density). Tight gap (gap-4 or gap-6). Use for displaying extracted claims (Organizations, Sender, Links, etc.).
grids.cardless: Avoid standard generic cards. Use 1px border grids that collapse (border-collapse) to create a technical, data-heavy look.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside containers. py-20 for footers/bottom sections.
layouts.mobile_first: Start with grid-cols-1. Ensure all elements are legible on small screens. Tap targets minimum 44px.
layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical alignment. Content must flow logically from top to bottom.

motion.accordion: Subtle ease-out (200-300ms) for 'More details' expansion. Scroll into view on mobile.
motion.hover: Explicit text color changes on hover (e.g., hover:bg-white/10 hover:text-white).
motion.micro_interactions: Active states on buttons scale down slightly (-translate-y-px or scale-95).

accessibility.contrast: APCA standard. Ensure text on warning/block colors is readable (e.g., black text on Yellow warning background).
accessibility.aria: aria-expanded for accordions. aria-hidden for decorative icons.
accessibility.data_testids: MANDATORY. Add data-testid to all buttons, accordion triggers, and key result sections (e.g., data-testid='higgins-recommendation', data-testid='more-details-accordion').

image_urls.description: Red padlock on keyboard. Use as abstract header graphic for 'Block' state or Threat Assessment header.
Mobile phone in front of laptop. Use for 'Screenshot Intake' or upload empty state.

instructions_to_main_agent: Focus primarily on app/message.js. Create the result hierarchy exactly as requested.

LEAD WITH ACTION: The top of the screen MUST show Higgins' clear next step recommendation and whether this is a WARNING or a BLOCK. 'Apollo is biting' is a BLOCK (requires red UI). Warnings use yellow.
HIGGINS EXPLANATION: Follow the hero with Higgins' clear text: What was found, why it matters, what could not be established.
EXTRACTION BENTO GRID: Show extracted data (claimed organizations, sender, links) using a technical Mode B grid. Use badges for 'Corroborated', 'Suspicious', 'Unresolved'.
MORE DETAILS: Put supporting sources, raw technical data, and relevant account/breach checks inside a Shadcn Accordion labeled 'More details'.
PRIVACY NOTICE: Add a bottom disclosure stating: 'Purpose-limited processing: Submitted content is assessed and immediately discarded...'.
SCREENSHOT INTAKE: Create a streamlined upload area for screenshot OCR submission.
Do NOT redesign unrelated screens. Only implement the message assessment and intake in app/message.js.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds in headers or dropdowns that content scrolls under. Use glassmorphism or solid backgrounds.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT:
You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
- Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients
- Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
- Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy
- Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur)
- You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
- You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
- Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style
- NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
- Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
- Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
- Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
- Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
- Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
- Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed
- Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones
- Use `sonner` for toasts. Sonner component are located in `/app/src/components/ui/sonner.js` (or .tsx if applicable, adjust based on actual env).
- All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
